_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; scenario P/E = percentiles of ACN's own 10-yr P/E on current-FY EPS; EPP P/E = median panic trough

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30 and already repricing obvious losers (Chegg, 2023-05-02), but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 25.8x FY23E — a premium, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting deflation or GenAI shows up as shrinking billable hours.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.24x; +43% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.27; conservative 2yr -3%.

BEAR.desc: Consulting recession spreads to managed services; pricing concessions; P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: Mid-single-digit LC growth, 10-20bp/yr margin, buyback; P/E reverts to its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: GenAI becomes a cloud-sized services cycle; growth back to 8-10% LC; P/E holds 75th pct

XBULL.desc: Re-run of the FY21-22 boom: double-digit growth and a 30x multiple

robustness.variant: EPP at 21x (2022-23 trough, no v2 penalty)

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-06-23) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.24x (31.0% downside to Bear $206 / +25.0% upside to Bull $373) | Adj composite 1.96 vs market 3.23: gap -1.27 [OVERVALUED] | +43% above the EPP floor $208 (18x FY23E $11.57) | Conservative 2-yr case: -2.8% total (-1.4%/yr) | At 25.8x FY23E the price needs the bull case while consulting is -1% LC and the Q4 guide is +2-6% LC; GenAI is a live theme but priced as a tailwind, not a threat.
